subject: Transitioning next week's demo into an engineering breakout — travel conflict / agenda
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlashealth.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Patel <maya@atlashealth.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Next week intro demo

Hey Markus —

Thanks for the invite. A couple things on our side: our CTO (Maya) will be traveling the week of Aug 23-25 and can't make live sessions then. Also, after talking internally, we want to make the session more hands‑on — ideally a short architecture sync followed by a 90–120 minute engineering breakout to validate token throughput and inference latency against our sample dataset.

Can we reframe the call from a 45m intro demo into a 2.5h engineering breakout and re-run availability? If that doesn't work for Maya, would it be possible to do an async prework + a shorter live deep dive with our infra lead?

Sanjay
Sanjay Rao
Director of Platform Engineering
Atlas Health

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Aug 2027 08:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next week intro demo

Sanjay —

Appreciate the context. We can absolutely switch formats. Two quick options to propose:

1) On‑site / live engineering breakout — 2.5 hours: architecture kickoff (20m), hands‑on POC exercises with their sample payloads (90m), profiling & next steps (40m). We'd want your infra lead + one SWE + Maya if she can join the first 20m.

2) Hybrid: async prework (we'll run a short warm‑up using your sample dataset and share results) + 60–75m live deep dive focused on bottlenecks & rollout considerations. This is lower lift but still surfaces the perf numbers.

Constraints to flag: Olga will be traveling Aug 24 (half day) but is available Aug 26 in the afternoon PST. Laura can host either morning slots on Aug 27–28. If Maya's travel window is 23–25, the on‑site option looks tight unless we move earlier (Aug 20/21) — are any earlier windows possible on your end?

I'll attach a draft agenda and a quick checklist for sample payloads we need. If you prefer, I can send updated invites once we lock the format.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachment: POC_agenda_v1.pdf
From: Maya Patel <maya@atlashealth.com>

Date: Wed, 18 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next week intro demo

Hi all —

Thanks for proposing the switch. I'm out traveling Aug 23–25 as Sanjay mentioned. We can do one of two things from my side:

- If you can run async prework and surface perf numbers ahead of time, I can review the results and join a 60m live session (Aug 26–28) where we focus on questions and rollout implications.
- If you need me in-person for the architecture kickoff, earliest I can be available is Tue Aug 31.

For the async prework, what do you need from our infra team? We can carve out ~2 hours for them to provide datasets and short scripts but we'd need your exact checklist.

Maya

Subject: Re: Next week intro demo — updated plan + logistics

Folks —

Thanks for the quick replies. Based on availability, here's what I recommend and will action:

Plan chosen: Hybrid option (async prework + 75m live deep dive) — this respects Maya's travel window and still gives engineering the hands‑on results they asked for.

What Redwood will do (prework, by Wed Aug 25):
- Run two quick inference runs against the sample payloads you send (small/medium batch sizes). We'll measure p50/p95 latency, token throughput, and memory footprint.
- Produce a 2‑page summary and a short recording showing how we ran the profiling.
- Draft a focused 75m agenda for the live deep dive (architecture Q+A, perf walkthrough, rollout checklist). See attached SOW_outline.docx for proposed goals and success criteria.

What we need from Atlas (by Tue Aug 24 EOD):
- Representative sample payloads (2–3 files) and a short README with data shapes and batching expectations.
- Contact for infra lead who can be on standby for a 20m sync if needed during the live session.

Proposed live session slots (pick one):
- Thu Aug 26, 10:00–11:15am PT
- Fri Aug 27, 1:00–2:15pm PT
- Mon Aug 30, 9:00–10:15am PT

Next steps: I'll drop a draft calendar invite after you confirm the slot and attach the prework checklist. If you prefer a different slot, call it out and we'll try to accommodate.

Thanks —
Markus
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment: SOW_outline.docx
